description: Declared coded-bitrate Layer III matrix: every MPEG version/rate, all 14 non-free bitrate indexes, and four channel modes. Synthetic long-block streams have independently coded nonzero channels and no reservoir. These establish syntax coverage, not encoder diversity or coverage of every possible coding tool combination.
excluded_from_this_matrix: all joint intensity/mixed/short combinations (separate compatibility fixtures)
8 kHz mixed independent PCM (separate documented subset validator)
